text: But when the war broke out that August. <break time="0.8s" /> Michael who had been a sergeant in his schools Officers Training Corps. <break time="0.8s" /> Wanted to enlist at once. <break time="0.8s" /> As an ordinary soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> Instead he was persuaded to accept a commission. <break time="0.8s" /> In a battalion so new. <break time="0.8s" /> That some of its men still wore old red uniforms. <break time="0.8s" /> And so he became a lieutenant. <break time="0.8s" /> For months. <break time="0.8s" /> The battalion guarded the English coast. <break time="0.8s" /> And a Scottish estuary. <break time="0.8s" /> And not until later. <break time="0.8s" /> Was it sent to France. <break time="0.8s" /> Where it moved from one sector to another. <break time="0.8s" /> Before reaching Ypres. <break time="0.8s" /> Michael wrote home. <break time="0.8s" /> That there was nothing special going on but about a month later. <break time="0.8s" /> A fragment of a shell. <break time="0.8s" /> Falling out of a wet dawn. <break time="0.8s" /> Killed him instantly. <break time="0.8s" /> The next shell buried his body. <break time="0.8s" /> Beneath the ruined foundations of a barn wall. <break time="0.8s" /> And for a long time. <break time="0.8s" /> No trace of him could be found. <break time="0.8s" /> When the telegram announced. <break time="0.8s" /> That Michael was missing. <break time="0.8s" /> Helen told herself. <break time="0.8s" /> That missing always means dead. <break time="0.8s" /> And the inquiries she made. <break time="0.8s" /> Through various organizations. <break time="0.8s" /> Brought her no news. <break time="0.8s" /> In the months that followed. <break time="0.8s" /> She felt strangely numb. <break time="0.8s" /> As if life were going on somewhere far away. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the Armistice. <break time="0.8s" /> Which ended the war. <break time="0.8s" /> Passed over her unnoticed. <break time="0.8s" /> At last she was officially informed. <break time="0.8s" /> That his body had been found, identified. <break time="0.8s" /> And buried again. <break time="0.8s" /> In Hagenzeele Third Military Cemetery. <break time="0.8s" /> And she received his identity disc and watch.
